timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, my name is Pajat Kare.
I am a bit of solitary person.
So even in Singapore I have chosen to live right at the edge of the city, district called
Ishim.
Plately I have been very interested in following birds.
Somebody told me what I am doing is, it falls in a faculty called Ornithology.
I am the global prestige leader in Mediacom.
Mediacom is global.
We not only work within our own offices and within our own geographies, we work as a network
across several offices and geographies.
It's informal, it is risk-taking, it allows autonomy, which I really enjoy.
It's full of exciting people, a lot of smart and diverse people work in the company.
It could be one of the companies which have the most diverse set of talent.
Mediacom has for a long time stood by what we call people first, better results.
Essentially summarizes the huge importance that we want to give to our internal talent.
What I really enjoy the most is the fact that no one prescribes to me what I should be doing
and how I should be doing it, as long as we as a team have a very clear understanding
and agreement on what is our end and goal.
I think my colleagues and my team would see me as someone who is not afraid, not to fail
to me is more important to take decision and to learn and to optimize versus not to take
a decision and to keep waiting for perfection to arrive.
